author: Apprehensive-Nose646
body:
Don't upgrade them, keep them at 10. Use wild towers to farm tower shards, use your towers to farm adornments, and to have towers to use for things like the current dragon event towers or to complete quests. 

Getting towers to a useful height is prohibitively expensive in orns, you are better off saving orns for ascension.

author: EnvironmentIcy4996
body: I have one just at lvl 10 so that when I get the daily quest to finish a tower but dont feel like doing a tower it keeps it easy for me

author: Depressed_Dodongo64
body: I can do about two towers a week but I wish I could have like 5 small ones in rotation just to constantly be making shards

author: Fluffabru
body:
I was able to get my first celestial class using the event dragon key on my two towers. They only had 10 floors but the key gave them 12 floors and felt like I more tower shards than normal.

Without buffs to shard drop I got around 10k a go.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Absolutely focus on your celestial classes and weapons before leveling your own towers. I can see benefits to buying the base towers, but I wouldn't spend shards leveling them at all. I would aim for GSA -> Celestial Axe -> GSH.

Living through towers and bosses is going to be your biggest challenge, so focusing on the tanky class and weapon first makes sense to me.
